name: Eligibility 507.1 — Coverage Termination (PX_CB Bypass) Navigator

steps.hint: Click the 'Event Resolution' tab. The active Edit PX_507 (member coverage terminated) is highlighted in red.
steps.name: Identify the PX_507 hard edit on Event Resolution
steps.description: Navigate to the Event Resolution tab. A hard-edit card for Event PX_507 will be displayed. This is the event you need to resolve.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the PX_507 hard edit on Event Resolution
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes as soon as the trainee opens the Event Resolution tab.

steps.hint: Open the 'Member Info' tab and note the seven highlighted identity fields — you'll cross-check them on Claim Image next.
steps.name: Review member identity fields
steps.description: Open the Member Information tab and review the seven identity fields: First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Sex, Group ID, and Member Prefix. These fields will be cross-checked against the Claim Image in the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens Member Info.

steps.hint: Click the 'Claim Image' tab and compare the seven highlighted fields against what you noted on Member Info.
steps.name: Cross-check member fields against the Claim Image
steps.description: Verify that all seven identity fields on the Member Information tab — First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Sex, Group ID, and Member Prefix — match the corresponding details on the Claim Image tab exactly.
steps.checklistItem: Cross-check member fields against the Claim Image
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claim Image tab.

steps.hint: Open the 'Search' tab (the 'Member' sub-tab opens by default), then click the Search button to run the lookup. Check Business Unit — it reads 'Individual' here — then note the Group ID, Member Prefix, Effective Date and Termination Date.
steps.name: Look up the contract on Search → Member
steps.description: Navigate to the Search tab, select the Member sub-tab, and open the Member General Information section. Review the Business Unit field to determine the contract type. The available Business Unit values are Large Group, Small Group, and Individual. Large Group cases should be handled according to the dedicated SOP-defined process, while Small Group and Individual follow the standard shared process. Since the current Business Unit is Individual, record the following details:Group ID, Member Prefix, Effective Date, and Termination Date.
steps.checklistItem: Look up the contract on Search → Member
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee clicks the Search button on the Search → Member sub-tab (fires the 'Search member' action). Opening the Search tab/sub-tab alone no longer completes this step.

steps.hint: Return to the Member Info tab and review the Group ID and Member Prefix (highlighted) — both should match the Search → Member panel.
steps.name: Confirm Group ID and Prefix on Member Info
steps.description: Confirm that the Group ID and Member Prefix on the Search tab (Member sub-tab) align with the values on the Member Information tab. The Group ID matches in this case.
steps.checklistItem: Confirm Group ID and Prefix on Member Info
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Member Info tab while this step is active.

steps.hint: Open 'Claim Lines' and verify the line's From / To dates fall inside the member's Effective – End date range.
steps.name: Verify service dates on Claim Lines
steps.description: Verify that the 'From' and 'To' dates on the Claim Lines tab fall within the Effective Date and End Date range on the Member sub-tab. If the claim is not keyed under the correct active Group ID, follow the alternate SOP steps; if keyed correctly, proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Verify service dates on Claim Lines
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes on first visit to the Claim Lines tab.

steps.hint: Go back to the 'Event Resolution' tab and find the 'Bypass Codes' section next to the PX_507 card.
steps.name: Return to Event resolution tab
steps.description: Return to the Event Resolution tab to select the PX_CB bypass code.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee returns to the Event Resolution tab while this step is active.

steps.hint: In the 'Bypass Codes' section pick 'PX_CB — Coverage bypass', then click 'Validate' in the claim summary bar.
steps.name: Apply PX_CB bypass and Validate
steps.description: In the Bypass Codes section pick the PX_CB bypass code, then click Validate in the claim summary.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when the trainee clicks the header Validate button while the selected bypass code is 'PX_CB' (PX_CB — Coverage bypass). Any other code does not complete the step.

steps.hint: Action menu → Pay, then click Submit.
steps.name: Submit the Pay decision
steps.description: Open the Action menu, select 'Pay', then click the Submit button. The attempt finalizes and your time is recorded.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee submits the Pay decision with the Submit button.

description: Resolve Edit PX_507 (member coverage terminated): verify member identity, confirm the keyed group and coverage window, then apply the PX_CB bypass and submit Pay.

stepSummaryForResults.name: Contract looked up on Search → Member
